explanation: Adds compareCell.ts: compareCell(column, popDataMap, gene) returns unavailable, not-detected or measured (own spelling, DE record, per-arm samples with n, mean and SEM via getGroupColumns + valueAt). tallyGene now takes cells; compareSummaryRows, compareSummaryLongRows and compareValueRows, the CompareGenesView tiles and both summary tables, the Compare tab chart ZIP and the pathway view's leading-edge table and export all read cells. compareSummaryRows skips unavailable columns, takes the compare-set tally as an option, and leaves group means blank when a column has no DE row for the gene.
